Seasonal hepatic and climatic series of Dendropsophus minutus

Source: R/data.R
dminutus_liver.Rd

Monthly means of four hepatic modules and of climate for the treefrog Dendropsophus minutus at a site in southeastern Brazil (20.8992° S, 49.3502° W), sampled independently each month from April 2016 to March 2017. Each module is a set of variables measured on the same individuals, averaged by month, so every element is a 12-row series covering one annual cycle.

Usage

dminutus_liver

Format

A named list of five numeric matrices, each with 12 rows (months, named "2016-04" to "2017-03"):

Somatic

Scaled mass index (mean_smi), hepatosomatic index (mean_ihs), body mass (mean_weight) and snout–vent length (mean_size).

Histochemistry

Mean area of hemosiderin (hemosiderin), glycogen (mean_gli), melanin (mean_mel) and lipofuscin (mean_lipo) per image.

Morphometry

Hepatocyte area and volume (mean_cellA, mean_cellV), nuclear volume and area (mean_nuV, mean_nuA) and nucleus–cytoplasm ratio (mean_ncr).

Density

Volumetric density of hepatocytes, sinusoids, melanomacrophage centers (cmm) and portal tissue, as centered log-ratios.

Climate

Mean daily minimum and maximum temperature (Tmin, Tmax, °C), Palmer drought severity index (Drought), mean daily rainfall (Rainfall, mm), relative humidity (RH, %), UV-B irradiance (UVB, J m\(^{-2}\) per day) and photoperiod with civil twilight (photoperiod, h).

Source

Hepatic data: Franco-Belussi, L., Moraes, L., de Oliveira, C., Fernandes, C. E. and Provete, D. B. (2026). Data and code for: Seasonal hepatic plasticity follows a temporal response hierarchy in a Neotropical frog. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.21613832 . Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Climate: temperature, rainfall and humidity from BR-DWGD (Xavier et al. 2022, doi:10.1002/joc.7731 ); drought from TerraClimate (Abatzoglou et al. 2018, doi:10.1038/sdata.2017.191 ); UV-B from glUV (Beckmann et al. 2014, doi:10.1111/2041-210X.12168 ); photoperiod computed for the site coordinates. Cite these sources when using the corresponding variables.

Examples

str(dminutus_liver)
#> List of 5
#>  $ Somatic       : num [1:12, 1:4] 0.598 0.685 0.675 0.66 0.628 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:12] "2016-04" "2016-05" "2016-06" "2016-07" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:4] "mean_smi" "mean_ihs" "mean_weight" "mean_size"
#>  $ Histochemistry: num [1:12, 1:4] 750.7 89.6 1048.6 569.9 454.7 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:12] "2016-04" "2016-05" "2016-06" "2016-07" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:4] "hemosiderin" "mean_gli" "mean_mel" "mean_lipo"
#>  $ Morphometry   : num [1:12, 1:5] 143 150 141 123 100 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:12] "2016-04" "2016-05" "2016-06" "2016-07" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:5] "mean_cellA" "mean_cellV" "mean_nuV" "mean_nuA" ...
#>  $ Density       : num [1:12, 1:4] 2.22 2.26 2.58 2.31 2.35 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:12] "2016-04" "2016-05" "2016-06" "2016-07" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:4] "hepatocyte" "sinusoid" "cmm" "portal"
#>  $ Climate       : num [1:12, 1:7] 17.4 14.3 12.6 11.3 13.2 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:12] "2016-04" "2016-05" "2016-06" "2016-07" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:7] "Tmin" "Tmax" "Drought" "Rainfall" ...
fit <- lagged_protest(dminutus_liver$Climate,
                      dminutus_liver$Histochemistry, lags = 0:3,
                      nperm = 199, seed = 1)
fit$optimal_lag
#> [1] 3
